lesson: Review-rejection records under plans/lessons/*.json are part of the ordinary Decision 0022 lesson ledger: load_lessons reads that directory through read_ledger_records, relevant_lessons filters matching scopes, and review briefs render them. Fresh combined generations start new roots; rejected_findings remain in their immutable rejection lineage and are not copied into a fresh provider assessment.
